name: Late fee already paid above the recalculated amount moves to the payer's advance
title: SC-09-04-07 Late fee already paid above the recalculated amount moves to the payer's advance
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a liability of 1400.00 whose 70.00 late fee was already paid
When a payment of 1400.00 dated 5 days after the due date is recorded
Then the late fee becomes 11.67
And the 58.33 paid above it is credited to the payer's advance
